title: Only 7% Pass This Car Mechanic Quiz
summary: Warning lights, hidden faults and strange road symptoms test whether you can diagnose trouble before it gets expensive.

landing.intro: From warning lights to strange noises, prove you can find the fault before the repair bill arrives.

about.body:
This practical car mechanic quiz turns dashboard warnings, vehicle systems and everyday fault symptoms into ten increasingly difficult workshop rounds. Questions cover engines and fuel, braking and road grip, electrical starting systems, cooling and fluids, drivetrain and steering, diagnosis and essential vehicle safety.

The challenge is designed for curious car owners and enthusiasts who enjoy automotive knowledge, maintenance basics and diagnostic problem-solving. Some questions test familiar warning signs, while others ask you to follow a component sequence, compare two symptoms or identify the safest next step without carrying out a repair.

Your final score reflects only the answers selected in this entertainment quiz. Vehicles and procedures differ, so the result is a playful snapshot of the systems you recognised most confidently rather than proof of professional competence.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Answer six questions in each workshop round and choose the single option you think is best.
Correct answers stay hidden while you play, so diagnose each clue before the quiz moves on.
Complete all ten rounds to reveal your Mechanic Score, strongest system and trickiest area.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz is not a professional qualification or vehicle-repair diagnosis. Vehicles differ; consult the manufacturer’s guidance and a qualified technician.

questions.question: Which warning symbol most directly relates to engine oil pressure?
A red brake warning stays on after the parking brake is released. What is the safest response?
answers: Stop safely and have the brake system checked
Ignore it until the next service

questions.question: The starter produces one solid click but does not turn the engine. Which is the most useful first check?
The temperature warning turns red while driving. What should you do?
answers: Pour cold water on the engine
Stop safely, switch off and let the system cool

questions.question: Which control changes the direction of the front wheels?
Before inspecting any unfamiliar fault, what should come first?
answers: Making the vehicle and work area safe

questions.question: Which sequence correctly describes air entering a typical combustion engine?

visual.ariaLabel: Air inlet, filter, intake system, engine

questions.question: Which part cleans dust from the air before it reaches the engine?
Which fluid primarily lubricates moving parts inside the engine?
Why must a hot pressurised cooling-system cap remain closed?
answers: Escaping hot coolant and steam can cause severe burns

questions.question: The coolant level keeps falling but no puddle is visible. What does that suggest?
answers: A leak may occur only when hot or internally

questions.question: Brake fluid has dropped below its marked minimum. What is the correct response?
answers: Ignore it if braking feels normal
Have the braking system inspected for wear or leakage

questions.question: Thick black smoke from a combustion engine usually suggests what?
answers: Too much fuel or too little air

questions.question: Brake fluid can damage paint. What should happen after a spill?
answers: Follow the manufacturer’s safe clean-up guidance immediately

questions.question: A rhythmic clicking becomes faster on tight turns. Which part is a likely cause?
One tyre has a deep sidewall bulge. What should you do?
answers: Stop using the tyre and arrange replacement

questions.question: A combustion engine needs which basic combination to run?

visual.ariaLabel: Air plus fuel plus ignition plus compression

answers: Air, fuel, compression and correctly timed ignition
Oil, steering angle and tyre pressure

questions.question: A blocked air filter is most likely to cause what?
answers: Restricted airflow and reduced engine performance

questions.question: One cylinder misfires and its spark plug is badly worn. What is the most direct link?
answers: The plug may fail to ignite the mixture reliably

questions.question: A fuel injector’s basic job is to do what?
The engine overheats in traffic but cools at road speed. Which component deserves an early check?
Which sensor commonly tells the engine computer how much air is entering?
A healthy 12-volt battery reads about 12.6 V at rest. This one reads 10.5 V. What does that suggest?

visual.ariaLabel: Expected battery voltage 12.6 volts, measured 10.5 volts

answers: The battery is deeply discharged or has a failed cell

questions.question: Before probing an unfamiliar electrical connector, what is safest?
answers: Consult correct service information and use suitable test equipment

questions.question: The steering wheel vibrates mainly at one road-speed range. What is a likely first suspect?
The car pulls to one side on a level road. Which area should be checked?
Engine speed rises sharply but road speed barely increases. What is likely slipping?
A low humming grows louder with road speed, even in neutral. Which component is a likely source?
The whole car shakes only when braking from higher speed. What is a common cause?
A new severe vibration appears after striking a road hazard. What should you do?
answers: Increase speed to smooth it out
Stop safely and inspect the wheel and tyre before continuing
Ignore it if no warning appears

questions.question: What recharges the 12-volt battery while driving?
Which fluid prevents freezing and carries engine heat?
“The car pulls left only while braking, and the left front wheel becomes unusually hot.” What is most likely?
“The battery is new, but it repeatedly goes flat and the charging warning appears while driving.” What should be tested?
answers: The charging system and its connections

questions.question: “The vibration follows road speed, not engine speed, and remains when coasting.” Which area fits best?
“There is a clunk when changing from acceleration to deceleration.” What is a sensible first area to inspect?
“A grinding noise began suddenly from one wheel.” What is the safest response?
An engine cranks, has fuel pressure, but has no spark on any cylinder. Which system should be investigated next?

visual.ariaLabel: Engine cranks, fuel pressure present, no spark

answers: Ignition control and its power or timing inputs

questions.question: On a conventional 12-volt charging system, battery voltage is 12.5 V with the engine off and 12.0 V while running with the lights on. What is the best diagnosis?

visual.ariaLabel: Conventional 12-volt charging system: engine off 12.5 volts, engine running with lights 12.0 volts

answers: The charging system is not supplying enough voltage

questions.question: The engine overheats only at idle, the radiator is unobstructed and the cooling fan never runs. What should be diagnosed first?

visual.ariaLabel: Engine cools at road speed, overheats at idle, cooling fan does not run

answers: The fan circuit, motor and control command
